scenes.tts: How does one cell divide into two sisters that are different from the moment they are born? Take the sensory organ precursor of a fly. A bristle is a small sense organ of four cells, and all four come from this one precursor. It divides, and the two daughters take different paths. One daughter goes on to make the neuron and its sheath. Its sister goes on to make the hair and its socket.
scenes.visual: One cell divides into two daughters with question marks, which then become neuron-and-sheath (left) and hair-and-socket (right).
scenes.narration: How does one cell divide into two sisters that are different from the moment they are born? Take the sensory organ precursor of a fly. A bristle is a small sense organ of four cells, and all four come from this one precursor. It divides, and the two daughters take different paths. One daughter goes on to make the neuron and its sheath. Its sister goes on to make the hair and its socket.

scenes.tts: Before division, a protein called Numb gathers on one half of the cell membrane. It forms a crescent. Scientists saw this by staining dividing cells with an antibody to Numb. When the cell divides, the crescent goes into one daughter only. The other daughter gets none.
scenes.visual: A yellow crescent grows on the left half of the cell; the cell divides and the crescent ends in the left daughter only.
scenes.narration: Before division, a protein called Numb gathers on one half of the cell membrane. It forms a crescent. Scientists saw this by staining dividing cells with an antibody to Numb. When the cell divides, the crescent goes into one daughter only. The other daughter gets none.

scenes.tts: What does Numb act on? Notch is a receptor that signals only between touching cells. When it is activated, it is cut, and its inner part can switch genes on. The two sisters touch, so each could signal to the other through Notch. Numb switches off Notch in the daughter that inherits it. How it does this is still argued.
scenes.visual: Notch receptors and signal arrows between the touching sisters; a red block shuts the signal into the Numb daughter.
scenes.narration: What does Numb act on? Notch is a receptor that signals only between touching cells. When it is activated, it is cut, and its inner part can switch genes on. The two sisters touch, so each could signal to the other through Notch. Numb switches off Notch in the daughter that inherits it. How it does this is still argued.

scenes.tts: The daughter with Numb cannot hear the message. Its sister can. The sister takes the Notch on, outer fate. It makes the hair and its socket. The daughter with Numb takes the Notch off, inner fate. It makes the neuron and its sheath. Numb does not tell the cell what to become. It is a private veto on a message from the sister, and it changes how the cell answers.
scenes.visual: Right daughter hears the signal and turns orange; left daughter, blocked, turns blue; fate chips appear.
scenes.narration: The daughter with Numb cannot hear the message. Its sister can. The sister takes the Notch on, outer fate. It makes the hair and its socket. The daughter with Numb takes the Notch off, inner fate. It makes the neuron and its sheath. Numb does not tell the cell what to become. It is a private veto on a message from the sister, and it changes how the cell answers.

scenes.tts: Now test the idea. Remove Numb, and nothing blocks Notch in either daughter. Both daughters take the outer fate. They make four outer support cells, all sockets, and no neuron. Now give Numb to both daughters. Neither can hear Notch. Both take the inner fate. They make neurons, and no bristle.
scenes.visual: Case one: no Numb, both signals open, both daughters orange. Reset. Case two: Numb in both, both signals blocked, both daughters blue.
scenes.narration: Now test the idea. Remove Numb, and nothing blocks Notch in either daughter. Both daughters take the outer fate. They make four outer support cells, all sockets, and no neuron. Now give Numb to both daughters. Neither can hear Notch. Both take the inner fate. They make neurons, and no bristle.

scenes.tts: That is the whole mechanism. Numb gathers on one side of the cell. Division hands it to one daughter only. There it blocks Notch, while the sister still hears the signal. Remember the rule: Numb goes to one daughter only, so the sisters differ.
scenes.visual: A compact replay: crescent, division, block, and the two fates.
